title: Fireflies.ai Reviews and Best Alternatives in 2026
summary: Updated October 2026 review of Fireflies.ai pricing, hidden credit costs, and the best alternatives for compliance-driven teams.
body_markdown:
Figuring out what Fireflies.ai actually costs takes a little more digging than the pricing page suggests. The per-seat number looks reasonable until you factor in AI credits, which are separate, limited, and sold in packs once your shared pool runs dry. This review covers the full pricing picture, what reviewers keep flagging as pain points, and how Fireflies stacks up against Spinach AI, the system of record for conversation data that deploys company-wide, and the other alternatives worth considering.


**TLDR:**


- Fireflies.ai runs on a per-seat model, but AskFred and AI Apps draw from a shared credit pool that runs out, adding cost beyond the headline price
- HIPAA, SSO, and SCIM are locked to the $39/seat Enterprise plan on annual billing only, with no monthly option to trial those controls
- Fireflies builds individual meeting libraries per user, with no central policy layer controlling what gets shared, retained, or deleted across your org
- No native path exists from a Fireflies meeting to a Jira or Linear ticket, so decisions still require manual follow-through
- Spinach AI deploys company-wide as the system of record for conversation data, routing structured outputs into Jira, Linear, Salesforce, and HubSpot when the meeting ends


## What Is Fireflies.ai and How Does It Work?


Fireflies.ai is an AI notetaker that joins your meetings via a bot, transcribes the conversation, and delivers summaries with action items when the meeting ends. It supports Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and other major conferencing tools, and syncs output to apps like Slack, Salesforce, HubSpot, Notion, and Asana, making it one of several options compared in our review of[AI transcription software](https://www.spinach.ai/blog/top-ai-transcription-software) .


Its primary audience is individual contributors, sales reps, and small-to-mid-size teams who want to stop taking notes manually. The product is built around a per-seat model, with each user getting their own library of recorded meetings.


For querying past meeting content, Fireflies offers AskFred, an AI chat interface that lets you ask questions across your meeting history. Advanced AI features, including AskFred and AI Apps, run on AI credits. As noted by[Claap’s pricing breakdown](https://www.claap.io/blog/fireflies-pricing) , each workspace gets a limited one-time pool of credits, with additional credits sold in monthly packs starting at $5 for 50.


One recurring criticism worth flagging early, and one worth weighing against[Otter AI pricing](https://www.spinach.ai/blog/otter-ai-pricing) as a benchmark:[Happy Scribe’s review](https://www.happyscribe.com/blog/fireflies-ai-review) found that Fireflies requires calendar access at signup (and won’t let you revoke it without deleting your account), the meeting bot is unreliable, and transcript accuracy is poor. For compliance-driven industries, the privacy model has also drawn scrutiny. These are worth knowing before you commit.

The per-seat price is only part of the story. AskFred and AI Apps draw from a shared workspace credit pool that is limited and one-time, according to[Claap’s pricing breakdown](https://www.claap.io/blog/fireflies-pricing) . Once that pool runs dry, additional credits are sold in monthly packs starting at $5 for 50 credits, a cost that sits entirely outside the headline number and compounds quickly for teams that rely on AI querying.


HIPAA coverage and SSO are locked to Enterprise at $39/seat/month on annual billing only, leaving compliance-bound teams with no shorter-term commitment option.


## Why Consider Fireflies.ai Alternatives?


Fireflies does a lot right. Native CRM sync, conversation analytics, support for 100-plus languages, and a feature set deep enough for sales and ops teams to get real value from, all at a price that’s hard to argue with on paper.


That said, a few specific gaps push organizations to look elsewhere.


The AI credits issue compounds the per-seat cost in ways the headline price doesn’t reflect, as covered above.


Enterprise controls are gated hard. SSO, SCIM, and HIPAA all require the $39/seat annual-only plan. There’s no monthly option and no way to trial those controls before committing to a year.


The governance architecture is the more fundamental issue for IT and compliance teams. Fireflies is built around individual libraries, not an organizational record. Every user has their own meeting history, with no central policy layer controlling what gets shared, retained, or deleted. For companies that need record-by-default deployment with enforced settings across the org, that structure does not fit.


Reviewers at[Happy Scribe](https://www.happyscribe.com/blog/fireflies-ai-review) also flagged bot consent behavior and privacy practices as concerns, particularly for compliance-sensitive industries. And for product and engineering teams, there’s no bi-directional ticket creation into Jira or Linear, so decisions and action items still require manual follow-through, a gap worth weighing if you’re also comparing project tools like in the[Spinach AI vs ClickUp](https://www.spinach.ai/blog/spinach-ai-vs-clickup) comparison.


## Best Fireflies.ai Alternatives in October 2026


Spinach AI is the strongest departure from Fireflies’ per-user library model. The six tools below cover the rest of the field worth considering.


### 1. Spinach AI: Best Overall Alternative


Spinach AI is an enterprise conversation intelligence platform and the system of record for conversation data. Where Fireflies gives each user their own library, Spinach deploys company-wide: one governed data asset, enforced policy, no shadow IT.


- Structured outputs routed natively into Jira, Linear, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other tools without manual re-entry
- Org-wide governance: SAML SSO, SCIM, PII redaction at the transcript level, and configurable retention per data type on Enterprise
- MCP server on Business and Enterprise for native Claude and ChatGPT connectors
- 100-language support with a transcription-model agnostic architecture


Best for organizations deploying across teams and functions, not a single rep or department. See how this plays out against revenue-focused platforms in the[Spinach AI vs Gong](https://www.spinach.ai/blog/spinach-ai-vs-gong-enterprise-conversation-data) comparison.


### 2. Granola


A personal AI notepad that runs locally on your Mac. Clean interface, solid summaries, but no CRM integrations, no project management connections, and no documented enterprise compliance posture.


- Good for: individual contributors who want lightweight notes
- Key limitation: no organizational layer whatsoever
- Bottom line: personal productivity tool only


### 3. Fathom


Strong free tier, individual-first design. No confirmed Slack Huddles support, and each user keeps their own library rather than feeding a shared organizational record.


- Good for: solo users or small teams watching budget
- Key limitation: no enterprise governance or structured ticket output
- Bottom line: a solid free notetaker, nothing more


### 4. tl;dv


Built for bottoms-up sales team adoption with an explicit sales coaching layer. No HIPAA or BAA, and no Slack Huddles or Webex support.


- Good for: sales teams wanting coaching features on a budget
- Key limitation: no compliance controls for compliance-sensitive industries
- Bottom line: sales-specific, not org-wide


### 5. Otter.ai


Six-language support caps its usefulness for multilingual organizations. The Business plan includes a 4-hour conversation limit and no Slack Huddles or Webex support.


- Good for: English-first teams wanting live transcription
- Key limitation: language ceiling and hard conversation caps
- Bottom line: narrows fast for international or high-volume teams


### 6. Circleback


Lightweight individual tool with limited integrations. No confirmed CRM push or PM ticket creation, and a limited enterprise compliance posture.


- Good for: users who want clean, simple meeting summaries
- Key limitation: little to offer IT or compliance buyers
- Bottom line: personal use only

## Why Spinach AI Is the Best Fireflies.ai Alternative


Fireflies.ai is a capable tool for individual contributors and sales teams who want meeting summaries and CRM sync without much setup. For that use case, it delivers. The gap shows up when an organization needs company-wide deployment with enforced policy, a single governed data asset, and no per-user silos driving shadow IT.


Spinach AI is built for that deployment. It joins meetings across Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, Slack Huddles, and Webex, captures during the meeting, and delivers structured decisions, action items with named owners, tickets, and CRM updates when the meeting ends, routed automatically into Jira, Linear, Salesforce, HubSpot, and the rest of the tools your teams already use. No manual re-entry, no ungoverned sharing, no credit pools running dry.

## Final Thoughts on Fireflies.ai Pricing and the Alternatives Worth Considering


Fireflies.ai pricing looks clean until you account for credit packs, the per-user silo model, and HIPAA locked behind annual Enterprise billing. For a single rep or a small team, that math can still work out fine. For an IT or compliance buyer who needs a governed record across the whole company, the structure just does not fit. Spinach AI is the system of record for conversation data: it joins the meeting, captures during it, and routes decisions, action items with named owners, and tickets into your tools when the meeting ends. If org-wide deployment with enforced policy is the actual requirement,[set up Spinach AI company-wide](https://www.spinach.ai/ai-setup) .


**Why do teams look for Fireflies.ai alternatives?**


The most common triggers are the AI credits model and the governance architecture. AskFred and AI Apps draw from a shared workspace credit pool that runs out, adding costs on top of your per-seat price. More fundamentally, Fireflies is built around individual user libraries with no central policy layer, which creates ungoverned sharing and shadow IT across teams.


**What should you focus on when choosing a Fireflies.ai replacement?**


Start with three criteria: org-wide deployment controls (enforced sharing scope, retention per data type, SAML SSO and SCIM), native integrations that route decisions and action items directly into your tools without manual re-entry, and compliance coverage at the tier your team actually needs. HIPAA on Fireflies requires an annual Enterprise commitment at $39/seat, so check whether alternatives offer that flexibility earlier in the buying process.


**When does switching from Fireflies.ai to Spinach AI make sense?**


The clearest signals are when your organization needs a single governed data asset across teams instead of per-user libraries, when engineering or product teams need bi-directional ticket creation into Jira or Linear, or when IT and compliance need enforced retention policies and PII redaction that apply across the whole org, not per user.


**How does Spinach AI pricing compare to Fireflies.ai for team-wide deployment?**


Spinach AI’s Business plan runs $19/user/month billed annually or $29/user/month monthly, with MCP included. Unlike Fireflies, there are no separate credit pools for AI querying: Ask Spinach is included in the plan price. Enterprise pricing is custom; contact sales at spinach.ai for org-wide deployments that need SAML SSO, SCIM, and configurable retention per data type.


**Can Spinach AI handle the compliance requirements that push teams off Fireflies.ai?**


Yes. Spinach AI is SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA compliant, with a BAA available only on Enterprise engagements (not on Business or lower tiers). It does not use voice biometrics, applies zero data retention terms with LLM providers, and supports PII redaction at the transcript level. Retention is configurable per data type, with transcript, summary, and video each settable separately from one week to indefinite on Enterprise, giving legal and compliance teams the controls Fireflies gates behind an annual-only plan.
